data.one_liner: Get unique device IDs across Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, macOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Retrieves platform-specific unique device identifiers such as BIOS UUID, IOPlatformUUID, AndroidId, IdentifierForVendor, and UserAgent using a unified API. It operates as a federated plugin covering all major desktop, mobile, and web platforms.
use_when: You need a unique device identifier across multiple platforms including desktop and web.
You want to retrieve standard device IDs like Android ID or vendor identifiers with minimal setup.
avoid_when: You need deep hardware inspection or extended device properties beyond just the device ID.
Privacy constraints prohibit tracking or utilizing hardware/vendor identifiers.
strengths: Supports a wide range of platforms: Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, macOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Relies on web UserAgent for web platforms, which may not be a stable hardware identifier.
Limited to fetching just the device ID without additional system metrics.
